numerators: Frozen 33 included Table2 entries and nested long_su from S2_BEERS_precheck/tables/drug_filtered; no redefinition/volume filtering
denominators: ATC second-level therapeutic groups; explicit unions for barbiturates/benzodiazepines/megestrol. Benchmark A10BB all SU as prior LASU. A denominator row counts once if any ingredient is in target class; combos not split. Retain all published denominator names, no low-volume threshold. Add each numerator row to denominator if ingredient classification misses it, record coverage exceptions; no outside therapeutic alternatives added post-fit.
classification: NLM RxClass ATC ingredient members, trans=0; save version, members, official class labels and exact matching rules before models. Normalize punctuation and spaces, use ingredient-boundary name matches; targeted synonyms recorded before model. Unmapped names preserved.
outcome: 30-day fills; ge65 visible, lt65=total-ge65; positive paired state-age-year cells. log(share) requires 0<p<=1; logit requires 0<p<1, no pseudocount; boundary exclusions retained.
model: old + old*(year-2013) + state*year FE; unweighted OLS; state-cluster CR1 full FE rank and t(G-1); same as original. No model tuning after outcomes.
comparators: a original national-age-PY log-volume; b log-share and logit-share; c original raw state log-volume. Use original outputs, not enrollment estimates.
percentile: 100*(number of Table2 betas below long_su +0.5*ties)/33; ties isclose abs_tol=1e-12, Q=min(4,floor(percentile/25)+1); boundaries 25/50/75 assigned upper quartile. Reference benchmark excluded from 33.
decision: INCLUDE iff all 33 Table2 betas and benchmark are estimable in each of a,b_log,b_logit,c and Q(a)==Q(b_log)==Q(b_logit)==Q(c). Otherwise DO_NOT_INCLUDE; no dropping entries to rescue percentile.
interpretation: Age-group trend differences only; under65 PartD largely disability-based entitlement. No Beers policy effect or causal effect claim. ATC broad classes are not indication-matched alternatives.
user_rule: same quartile across three approaches, both log and logit must satisfy
